errors.evidence: The description states the VideoLLaMB line extends to 200 frames, but the plot shows its last data point is well before that, at approximately 125 frames.
The description infers that the VideoLLaMB line is "leveling off" based on only two data points, which is an unsupported interpretation.

errors.text_span: remaining nearly flat at around 25 GB across the entire frame range
errors.evidence: This statement misrepresents the trend for VideoLLaMB-R. The line is not "nearly flat"; it shows a clear, steady increase from about 15 GB to about 38 GB. The value is not "around 25 GB" across the entire range; it only passes through 25 GB around the 500-frame mark.
The description identifies the line for LLava-NeXT as blue, but the legend and plot show it as teal.
